name: @forgeax/parity-urp-vs-hdrp
description: Standard direct-vs-clustered pixel-parity fixture. Renders the same scene (≤4 PointLight) twice through one Standard pipeline with different closed lighting lanes and exposes window.__captureLeft / __captureRight for scripts/bench/pixel-parity.mjs. AC-22: ε ≤ 0.001 ≤4 lights subset.

bundle-size.reason: fixture-only bundle; size variance is downstream of @forgeax/engine-runtime + @forgeax/engine-rhi-webgpu already tracked at the package level

fps.reason: static-frame fixture (one renderer.draw per capture, no rAF loop). FPS measurement is hello-cube / hello-room territory

gate.reason: no package-level binary gate; AC-22 ε ≤ 0.001 enforced via scripts/bench/pixel-parity.mjs Standard lanes target

spike-report.reason: not a spike app; this is the Standard lighting-lane parity fixture
